data.title: Senior Marketing Specialist (w/m/d)
data.description:
Context of the Role

To strengthen our Marketing Team, we are looking for a Senior Marketing Specialist to join us as soon as possible. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, implementing and continuously improving integrated B2B marketing activities that strengthen our market presence, generate qualified leads and support our international business growth. You will develop relevant content and campaigns across digital and offline channels, coordinate marketing initiatives with internal and external stakeholders and ensure consistent communication of our products, services and value proposition.
You will work closely with Product Mangaement, Sales, and futher other internal teams to develop our marketing programs and campaigns, addressing the needs of potential new customers and partners, based on our Product Portfolio as well as Go-To-Market Strategy. You will be instrumental for the further development of our marketing measures, performance measurement and communication standards.
For this position, residency in Germany as well as very good German and English skills, both written and spoken, are required. Occasional travel to trade fairs, conferences, customer events and internal meetings will be also relevant for your success.


Key Tasks

  • Owning our marketing demand generation programs: Planning, implementation, and measuring of integrated B2B marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels
  • Development of ABM-driven campaigns and activities that strengthen brand awareness, generate qualified leads by substantially supporting the achievement our revenue goals
  • Independent management of marketing campaigns and projects, including target groups, timelines, approvals, implementation and follow-up
  • Close cooperation with the Marketing Specialist for communication in the creation and coordination of website content, articles, newsletters, case studies, presentations, campaign materials and sales enablement content
  • Translation of complex software products and technical topics into clear and compelling marketing messages
  • Implementation of targeted marketing activities for specific industries, customer segments, products and business priorities
  • Close collaboration with Sales and Business Development on lead generation, target account activities and customer acquisition
  • Coordination with Product Management and our service teams regarding product developments, customer use cases and market requirements
  • Planning and coordination of trade fairs, conferences, webinars, customer events and related communication activities
  • Coordination of external agencies and service providers, including briefing, quality assurance and timeline management
  • Monitoring of marketing performance and preparation of KPI-based reports and improvement recommendations
  • Leading the lead management, lead nurturing and marketing automation processes
  • Market, competitor and target group research, as well as continuous improvement of marketing processes, tools and reporting structures


Required Skills

  • Several years of professional experience in B2B marketing, digital marketing, content marketing, campaign management or product marketing
  • Proven experience in independently planning, implementing and evaluating integrated marketing campaigns
  • Understanding of the structure and the approach on realizing Accout-Based-Marketing Programs
  • Experience in marketing activities that support lead generation, customer acquisition and business growth
  • Strong content development and copywriting skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly
  • Experience in marketing software products, IT solutions or consulting services, ideally in an international B2B environment
  • Industry experience in Energy, Chemicals, logistics or industrial software is an advantage
  • Strong understanding of websites, email marketing, social media, online campaigns and marketing automation
  • Experience in developing customer-focused content, campaign materials and sales enablement materials
  • Experience collaborating with Sales and Business Development on lead generation and growth initiatives
  • Ability to translate business priorities, market requirements and customer needs into effective marketing activities
  • Experience in marketing analytics, campaign performance measurement and KPI-based reporting
  • Confidence in working with CRM, content management, email marketing and analytics systems
  • Strong project management, organisational and stakeholder management skills
  • A structured, reliable and results-oriented approach, with high ownership and attention to detail
  • Very good German and English skills, willingness to travel occasionally and a relevant degree or comparable qualification
 
Note:
This is not an entry-level position. We therefore particularly welcome applications from candidates with at least five years of relevant professional experience in B2B marketing, digital marketing, content marketing, campaign management, product marketing or a comparable role. We also explicitly encourage people aged 50+ to apply!


Why us?

We offer a modern working environment where initiative, professional development and teamwork are highly valued:

  • Hybrid working and the option to work remotely, including temporary mobile working from abroad
  • Working time account to support a healthy work-life balance
  • 30 days of annual leave
  • An integrated career and development system with transparent perspectives
  • Professional development and continuous learning are important to us and are actively supported
  • JobRad: configure your JobRad, or even more than one
  • Team and company events that strengthen our open and collaborative culture
  • An international working environment with colleagues, customers and partners worldwide
  • A Works Council that provides advice and support
  • A growing global team and an innovative product environment
  • The opportunity to actively shape our market presence, marketing activities and future growth
The salary range for this position is 70.000 € to 90.000 € gross per year on a full-time basis. The specific classification within the salary range is based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, particularly relevant professional experience, qualifications and competencies.
In addition to the base salary, the position may include a variable compensation component based on clearly defined and measurable individual and company-related objectives. The specific compensation model will be communicated transparently during the recruitment process.

About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective, changing how autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. This gives our operators a decisive edge in highly contested environments. As threats rise, STARK is strengthening the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe.


About the team

Du wirst Teil unseres Teams an der Schnittstelle zwischen internationalem Handel, Exportkontrolle und dem operativen Tagesgeschäft bei STARK. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus verschiedenen Bereichen wie Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik zusammen. Von Anfang an arbeitest du an realen Fällen und sammelst praktische Erfahrung in einem schnelllebigen internationalen Umfeld.


Your mission

Als Werkstudent im Bereich Exportkontrolle unterstützt du uns dabei, nationale und internationale Exportkontrollvorgaben zuverlässig in unsere täglichen Geschäftsprozesse zu integrieren.

Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachabteilungen wie Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik zusammen und unterstützt bei konkreten Fragestellungen rund um Exportgenehmigungen, Sanktionen, Güterklassifizierungen und länderbezogene Restriktionen.

Dabei erhältst du direkten Einblick in reale Fälle des internationalen Handels- und Exportkontrollrechts und kannst dein theoretisches Wissen unmittelbar in der Praxis anwenden.


Responsibilities

  • Du beantwortest tägliche Fragen aus Fachabteilungen, zum Beispiel Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik, zu exportkontrollrelevanten Abläufen und Prüfschritten.
  • Du unterstützt aktiv bei der Vorbereitung und Ausarbeitung von Ausfuhrgenehmigungsanträgen beim Bundesamt für Wirtschaft und Ausfuhrkontrolle (BAFA).
  • Vor geplanten Exporten führst du Recherchen zu Exportgenehmigungen, Sanktionen, Güterklassifizierungen und länderbezogenen Restriktionen durch.
  • Du analysierst und dokumentierst vergangene Ausfuhr- und Zolldaten zur Risikoanalyse und zur Vorbereitung interner und externer Audits.
  • Du erstellst, prüfst und verwaltest eigenverantwortlich Endverbleibserklärungen für Kunden, Lieferanten und Behörden.


Qualifications

  • Du bist immatrikulierter Student (all genders) im Bereich Wirtschaftsrecht, Rechtswissenschaften, BWL, Logistik, International Business oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes Verständnis oder starkes Interesse am deutschen und europäischen Exportkontrollrecht, insbesondere AWG/AWV und der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung.
  • Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Regelungen verständlich zu vermitteln und deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen lösungsorientiert zu unterstützen.
  • Du arbeitest sehr sorgfältig, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich.

data.title: Tactical Data Link Expert (all genders)
data.description:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.
We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems—not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe—today.


About the team

Minerva is STARK's command and control software — the brain that connects operators to autonomous systems across multiple domains in real time. The Minerva team is a small, senior software group based in Berlin and Munich, working directly with our systems and hardware teams to build mission-critical C2 capabilities deployed in active operational environments.
We move fast, ship real software, and operate under constraints most engineers never encounter — low-bandwidth networks, air-gapped devices, high-stakes decision loops. There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field.


Your mission

Support the development, integration, testing, and operational use of tactical data link capabilities for STARK’s unmanned systems, Ground Control Stations, and wider command-and-control environments. You will help ensure that our systems can communicate reliably and securely with military networks, command posts, allied platforms, and mission systems. A key part of the role is to evaluate, understand, and integrate tactical communication standards and technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military data link solutions. You will translate operational communication requirements into practical integration concepts, test setups, and deployable system configurations.


Responsibilities

Tactical Data Link Integration: Support the integration of tactical data link capabilities such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military communication systems into STARK platforms and Ground Control Station environments.

Interoperability Concepts: Define and support communication concepts that enable reliable data exchange between unmanned systems, GCS setups, command centers, allied platforms, and external mission systems.

Requirements Translation: Translate operational and military communication requirements into technical integration requirements, interface definitions, test needs, and subsystem-level implementation concepts.

System Interface Support: Work with engineering, software, network, RF, modem, antenna, and GCS teams to align interfaces, protocols, data flows, configuration requirements, and integration constraints.

SATCOM & Beyond-Line-of-Sight Support: Support concepts and integration activities for SATCOM, long-range communication paths, and other beyond-line-of-sight connectivity options.

Testing & Validation: Plan and support lab tests, field tests, interoperability checks, and validation activities for tactical data link and communication setups.

Security & Reliability: Contribute to secure, robust, and mission-ready communication architectures, considering availability, latency, data integrity, authentication, and operational constraints.

Supplier & Partner Coordination: Work with external suppliers, partners, military stakeholders, and internal teams to assess data link options, integration dependencies, and technical feasibility.

Documentation: Document data link concepts, interface assumptions, configuration settings, integration dependencies, test results, and recommended operational setups in a clear and maintainable way.


Qualifications

Experience: Around 5 years of professional experience in tactical communications, military data links, SATCOM, RF systems, communication engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical field.

Tactical Data Link Knowledge: Practical understanding of military data link technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, or comparable tactical communication systems.

Systems Understanding: Ability to understand complex communication architectures involving platforms, radios, antennas, modems, networks, command systems, software interfaces, and operational workflows.

Interoperability Mindset: Strong understanding of how different systems exchange data, how interfaces are defined, and how interoperability is tested and validated.

Technical Communication: Ability to translate between operational users, engineering teams, software developers, RF specialists, suppliers, and program stakeholders.

Testing & Documentation: Experience supporting technical tests, integration trials, validation activities, or operational demonstrations, including structured documentation of results and findings.

Problem-Solving Ability: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify communication issues, integration gaps, configuration problems, and practical solutions.

Communication: Solid English skills are required. German skills for technical communication, stakeholder alignment, and documentation are a plus.

Team Fit: Ability to work collaboratively in a small, cross-functional team and communicate clearly and reliably in fast-moving engineering environments.

Clearance: Ability to obtain appropriate security clearance required for the position.


Nice to have

 Experience in defence, military communications, command-and-control systems, aerospace, naval systems, UAVs, or other mission-critical operational environments.

· Prior exposure to NATO communication standards, tactical networks, joint fires, air defence, command posts, or battlefield management systems.

· Experience with SATCOM terminals, tactical radios, MANET, IP-based tactical networks, or professional communication equipment.

· Experience integrating unmanned systems into wider military communication architectures.

· Understanding of network security, encryption concepts, authentication, routing, IP networking, and secure data exchange.

data.description:
About Us

Our team leads the independent validation and verification of complex software systems, bridging the gap between rigorous architectural requirements and deployed capabilities. We operate at the critical intersection of software development and system safety, ensuring every release meets the highest performance and reliability standards. You will work closely with cross-functional partners in sofware & hardware, and flight operations to maintain technical integrity in a fast-paced environment.


Your mission

As the Software IVV Lead, you will act as the independent software testing and verification authority, ensuring that the standards defined by our architecture are measurably adhered to, rigorously tested, and successfully audited. You will own the strategy, infrastructure, and execution of software validation and verification, serving as the ultimate quality gatekeeper for our software release candidates before they reach hardware integration and testing in the field.


Responsibilities

  • Define the Test Strategy: Establish and enforce the overarching software testing frameworks and QA processes (based on ISTQB) across all software capability teams.

  • Manage Test Infrastructure & Tooling: Oversee the setup and maintenance of software test environments and test data, ensure the qualification of testing tools, and lead the generation of audit-proof, revision-safe test evidence.

  • Oversee V&V Execution: Supervise the validation and verification phases of the V-Model, ensuring rigorous unit, integration, and sub-system-level testing are completed before handing over to the Hardware integration and Flight Testing teams.

  • Ensure Requirements Traceability: Deliver transparency in bidirectional traceability between Software Requirements, architectural design, implementation, and testing. Define and monitor the traceability processes in close collaboration with Software Configuration Management (SCM), ensuring operational compliance.

  • Govern Defect & Deviation Management: Establish and oversee the interfaces and processes for defect, deviation, and problem management, ensuring all findings from testing are systematically tracked, evaluated, and resolved.

  • Enforce Code Quality: Drive the adoption of strict coding standards (like MISRA for C++) using automated static analysis and code coverage metrics.

  • Interface with Configuration Management: Verify compliance with defined SCM processes, auditing baselines, versions, reproducible builds, Software Configuration Indexes, and Release Packages to ensure they meet quality standards.

  • Act as the Quality Gatekeeper: Provide independent quality gate approvals and formal release recommendations for software release candidates via the Engineering Change Request (ECR) process, while recognizing that the ultimate release decision resides with Product/Program Management.

  • Manage Audits: Lead the preparation, execution, and follow-up for all internal software QA assessments and external regulatory audits.


Qualifications

  • Proven experience in defining and enforcing software testing frameworks and QA processes based on ISTQB standards.

  • Deep expertise in managing the validation and verification (V&V) phases of the V-Model for complex software systems.

  • Hands-on experience with automated static analysis tools and enforcing coding standards such as MISRA for C++.

  • Strong background in requirements traceability and managing the interface between Software Requirements and test execution.

  • Solid knowledge of Software Configuration Management (SCM) processes, including version control, reproducible builds, and release auditing.

  • Demonstrated capability in defect and deviation management, ensuring systematic tracking and resolution of software findings.


Nice to have

The Senior Auditor will report directly to the Global Head of Internal Audit. This person will work closely with the Board, Audit Committee, key stakeholders and external auditors. data.title: Senior Software Engineer (Elite Motorsport)
data.description:
Senior Software Engineer (Motorsport)

DO YOU WANT TO WORK FOR THE WORLD LEADER IN ELITE SPORTS PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS?

Catapult is a world leader in sports performance technology, serving over 5000 teams across 40 sports. We improve many of your favorite athletes' performances with our wearable tracking technology, video and data analysis systems, and athlete management products. Our technology offers objective solutions to sport-based challenges and can be found throughout the NFL, NHL, NBA, AFL, NRL, Premier League, Bundesliga, La Liga and many more.

In Motorsport, Catapult's SBG race management and team strategy systems are the technology of choice for elite-level organisers and competitors around the world, including in Formula 1, Formula E, IndyCar, NASCAR, WEC/Le Mans and other worldwide endurance racing. Customers include the FIA (in F1, F2, F3, F1 Academy, FE and WEC), nine Formula 1 teams (including the 8-time World Champion Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team), the majority of Formula E teams, the winners of multiple Le Mans 24-hour races over the last 10 years (Audi, Porsche, and Toyota) and teams and organisers in both IndyCar and NASCAR. 

We have major offices in the UK (London and Leeds), USA (Boston) and Australia (Melbourne) as well as multiple smaller offices around the world.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SPORTS AND WANT TO WIN

We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Senior Software Engineer (Motorsport) to grow our Motorsport development team as we expand our RaceWatch products into new series and tackle new challenges.

Based in London, you will be a key player in developing new capabilities in RaceWatch, particularly for Endurance racing strategy, but also contributing to the entire RaceWatch suite across different racing series.

We believe that our customers deserve the best platform, and we are on a mission to maximise and enhance their performance through delivering the highest quality experience. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help us drive our products and processes forward, as well as acting as a mentor and providing technical leadership to other team members. You will be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the development of our RaceWatch software for one or more motorsport series.
  • Work with product managers and customers to design features and prioritise tasks.
  • Identify ways to add innovative new features to the software.
  • Lead others to anticipate and meet customer needs.
  • Be one of the technical leaders within the team.
  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
  • Ensure code quality, organization, and best practices throughout the development process.
  • Lead with a growth mindset, encouraging others to share ideas and opinions.
  • Maintain and enhance software reliability.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • A passion for Motorsport.
  • 5+ years working in a fast-paced, technical environment, delivering software to customers.
  • A proven track record of building applications in C/C++.
  • Experience developing products, scaling them, and supporting them throughout the entire lifecycle.
  • An aptitude for working with complex data.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff, both internally and when speaking to customers.
  • A willingness to go above and beyond for the customer.
  • Ability to help cover live motorsport events at weekends on a rotational basis with the rest of the team.
  • An ability to multi-task and thrive in a dynamic work environment with changing priorities.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Degree in computer science or other scientific or technical subject.
  • Prior experience working in motorsport is a strong advantage.
  • An understanding of the challenges faced by motorsport officials and teams in managing and participating in events.
  • Experience using Catapult's RaceWatch software.
  • Experience with ticketing and project management platforms, such as JIRA or Monday.
  • Experience developing Windows applications in Visual Studio.
  • Experience developing applications that process video.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication; to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries so you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures.
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.
  • We care about you. We offer outstanding paid maternity and paternity leave.

Whether you are interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams, organisations and competitors on the planet! While we have access to many exciting opportunities, we also realize that we are here to do a very important job for our customers. As a result, we aim to work with purpose and intention. We look for people that fit into our team culture, those who actively contribute and individuals who are excited about what they do. 

In order to build the future of sports performance, we need the brightest talent. If you think you can contribute to the empowering, enjoyable and exciting Catapult environment, then we invite you to apply.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

data.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role:  Senior Integrated Designer - 12 month FTC

Location:  London, United Kingdom  

About the role: 

As Senior Integrated Designer, you'll lead creative thinking and execution across the studio's full channel mix, from initial concept through to final delivery across digital, social, motion, print, and events. You'll bring both ideas and craft to every brief, ensuring work is visually strong, strategically considered, and consistent across touchpoints and markets. 

Operating within a regulated financial services environment, you'll bring discipline to compliance-sensitive materials, set quality benchmarks for the team, embed AI-assisted design workflows, and help build a studio the wider organisation is proud of. 

What you will be doing: 

 Integrated Design & Creative Production 

  • Concept and create on-brand integrated work across the full channel mix, brand campaigns, digital and social content, motion, print, events, marketing collateral, thought leadership, and long-form communications, from brief through to final delivery 
  • Bring integrated thinking to every brief, considering how ideas translate across channels, formats, and markets before execution begins 
  • Produce motion and animation work for digital and social, applying strong storytelling and timing principles alongside visual craft 
  • Adapt integrated design solutions for seven markets and multiple product lines, maintaining visual and conceptual consistency within brand guardrails; prepare all files to correct digital, motion, and print specifications 
  • Manage multiple live projects simultaneously, maintaining brand integrity, quality standards, and deadlines across all output 

 Brand Guardianship & Consistency 

  • Champion consistency of visual identity, tone, and quality across every touchpoint and market, proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen brand expression 
  • Apply compliance requirements, disclaimers, substantiation standards, and sign-off checkpoints, as standard practice, with approvals documented correctly 
  • Contribute to brand guidelines, scalable templates, and asset systems that enable speed and consistency across the studio 

 Team Leadership & Collaboration 

  • Lead, direct, and mentor the design team, providing clear creative briefs, constructive feedback, and development support that raises capability and output quality across the integrated mix 
  • Work closely with the embedded team and client stakeholders to develop integrated creative ideas, translating feedback into clear direction for the team 

 Gen AI & Agentic Thinking 

  • Apply advanced AI tools to enhance integrated creative output and workflows, building effective prompts, critically evaluating results, and maintaining rigorous human oversight of quality and compliance 
  • Design and embed AI-assisted workflows for the team, setting quality benchmarks and guiding responsible AI use across sizing, adaptation, motion, transcreation, and production efficiency 
  • Break down complex, multi-format creative challenges into clear steps, leading the team to the best outcome efficiently and adapting confidently when priorities shift 

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating integrated creative thinking and execution across digital, social, motion, print, and campaign formats, with evidence of both conceptual originality and hands-on craft 
  • Advanced proficiency across Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects) and Figma; expert understanding of graphic design, typography, motion, and digital production standards 
  • Proven ability to concept ideas that work across channels, not just adapt static design to new formats 
  • Experience producing motion and animation work for digital and social, with strong storytelling instincts alongside technical execution 
  • Experience producing integrated work for international or multi-market campaigns, adapting design systems across countries and channels within brand guardrails 
  • Deep understanding of brand identity systems, able to apply, protect, and evolve visual standards across a complex, multi-touchpoint portfolio 
  • Familiarity with regulated industries (financial services, insurance, or similar), or demonstrated ability to work within compliance, legal, and governance frameworks 
  • Experience contributing to brand guidelines, scalable templates, and asset systems that enable consistency and speed across a team 
  • Experience leading and mentoring designers, providing clear creative direction, developmental feedback, and coaching that builds integrated craft capability 
  • Confident presenting and defending integrated creative concepts to senior stakeholders, translating feedback into clear direction for the team 
  • Advanced use of AI tools relevant to integrated design, building effective workflows, evaluating outputs critically, and training others in responsible AI use 
  • Agentic mindset: able to lead a team through complex, multi-format creative challenges, adapting confidently when priorities shift and maintaining quality under pressure
  • Formal degrees are welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts. Experience can be gained through work, study, volunteering, or self-directed learning.

data.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role:  Global Head of Analytics

Location:  London, United Kingdom  (2-3 days a week from our London offices)

 

About the role: 

We're looking for a Global Head of Analytics to lead one of the most important practices in our business. This is a senior leadership role with genuine scope; you'll own a global team of around 80 people, spanning audience insight, creative performance analytics, social listening and measurement, search marketing and paid social, all embedded within in-house client teams across Europe, APAC, LATAM and North America. 

Reporting to OLIVER's Chief Strategy Officer, you'll sit at the intersection of creativity, technology and data. You'll help OLIVER and our clients understand not just what's performing, but why, and what to do next. You'll spearhead new solutions in driving creative effectiveness, and proving the value of the creative component of our clients' marketing. 

You'll work closely with Brandtech colleagues in packaging and scaling Group data solutions to drive more value from marketing. 

You'll also play a key role, with your Brandtech colleagues, in shaping how our proprietary Gen AI platform, Pencil, is powered by data and insight; making it smarter, faster and more impactful for the clients who rely on it. 

This is a role for someone who is as comfortable in a client boardroom as they are in a product sprint. Someone who can inspire a globally distributed team, spot commercial opportunity and translate complex data into stories that help businesses make better decisions. 

What you will be doing: 

  • Lead and develop the global analytics practice
    • Provide leadership to a globally distributed team of ~80 analysts and insight specialists, with six direct reports across disciplines and regions
    • Build and sustain a high-performance, collaborative team culture across a diverse, multi-disciplinary group
    • Define and continuously evolve OLIVER's analytics methodologies, tools and frameworks across search, paid social, social listening, audience insight and measurement — ensuring best practice is shared and applied globally
    • Ensure the team has the engineering capability to integrate data sources and build automated solutions at scale
    • Champion data and insight as a strategic differentiator — internally at OLIVER and externally with clients
  • Drive commercial growth
    • Own the analytics revenue line, accountable for delivering 10% year-on-year growth
    • Identify and develop new commercial opportunities: expanding services within existing client relationships and contributing to new business pitches
    • Work with senior client stakeholders to demonstrate and quantify the value of data-led decision-making
    • Act as a senior analytics partner and thought leader for key clients — particularly on creative effectiveness, audience understanding and performance measurement
    • Drive meaningful improvement in client satisfaction, targeting a five-point improvement in client NPS in year one
  • Build and launch new products
    • Partner with data and technology leaders across the Brandtech Group to co-develop proprietary data products and analytics capabilities, with a focus on the creative effectiveness space
    • Package and position Brandtech's data assets in ways that are compelling and value-driving for OLIVER's clients — particularly at the intersection of media, creativity and agentic commerce
    • Lead the scaling of OLIVER's Gen AI-enabled data products, including trend and competitor reporting tools and automated social reporting
    • Scale OLIVER's creative effectiveness measurement approach into a differentiating, client-facing capability
  • Embed Gen AI at the heart of insight
    • Play a central role in ensuring Pencil, Brandtech's proprietary Gen AI platform, is optimally enabled by data and insight
    • Stay at the frontier of Gen AI developments relevant to marketing analytics — bringing new ideas and applications into the business
    • Work with OLIVER's wider leadership team to embed AI-powered insight into client workflows and content ecosystems
  • Shape group-wide data strategy
    • Build strong relationships with Brandtech Group data leaders, contributing to group-wide thinking on data strategy and product development
    • Lead thinking on how media, creativity and data come together — and how LLM recommendation and agentic commerce will reshape content ecosystems

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • Significant senior leadership experience in analytics, data strategy or a related discipline, ideally within a creative or media agency, platform, or technology business
  • A track record of building and scaling high-performing, multi-disciplinary analytics teams in a global or multi-market context
  • Demonstrable success growing revenue and commercialising data or insight propositions
  • Experience developing and launching data products or insight tools, ideally in collaboration with technology partners
  • Deep familiarity with the marketing analytics landscape: performance measurement, audience insight, social listening, search, paid social and creative effectiveness
  • Exceptional strategic thinking — the ability to connect data to business outcomes in ways that resonate with C-suite and board-level stakeholders
  • Strong commercial instincts: experienced in identifying, shaping and closing revenue opportunities
  • Outstanding communication and storytelling skills — able to make complex data feel clear, relevant and actionable
  • Ability to lead and inspire distributed, culturally diverse teams across multiple time zones
  • Experienced in navigating and influencing complex, matrixed organisations
  • Sets the AI strategy for the analytics discipline across OLIVER's global portfolio
  • Genuine fluency in Gen AI and its applications in marketing and data — including hands-on experience building agents and agentic workflows
  • Develops AI capability across teams and client offerings; embeds AI-powered insight into client workflows at scale
  • Leads governance and quality standards for AI-assisted analytics across the practice
  • Contributes thought leadership on AI's role in data, creativity and marketing — internally across Brandtech and externally in the industry
  • Accountability for the analytics revenue line and year-on-year growth targets
  • Experience building and presenting commercial propositions from data and insight capabilities
  • P&L management experience across multiple markets or business lines
  • Track record of presenting financial performance to executive and board-level stakeholders
  •  Formal qualifications are welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts. Experience can be gained through work, independent research, or professional practice.

data.title: Director of Software Engineering
data.description:
The Role:

 

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 

The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system. 


What This Role Is Not: 

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. We need a director who writes code, reviews architecture, challenges technical decisions, and earns the team's respect through demonstrated craft and not just tenure or title. 


What You Will Work On:
 

Technical Leadership 

  • Define and own the technical roadmap for autonomous constellation operations
  • Set the architectural direction for the data platform, reliability systems, and automation infrastructure
  • Stay hands-on: review code, prototype solutions, and get into the details when it matters
  • Establish engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing, and observability, and hold the team to them
  • Be the person engineers come to when the problem is genuinely hard

Team Building & Culture 

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a team of 6 to 10 world-class reliability and platform engineers
  • Set the pace, tone, and ambition for the team and make being on it feel like a privilege
  • Create an environment where engineers grow fast, own their work, and ship things they are proud of
  • Identify gaps and level up engineers through mentorship and not just management

Operational Transformation 

  • Lead the shift from manual, operator-driven processes to fully automated and self-healing operations
  • Define and drive toward SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets for the constellation
  • Partner with satellite operations and mission teams to translate pain into software solutions

Cross-Functional Influence 

  • Be the technical voice of the team in company-wide conversations about architecture, infrastructure, and platform strategy
  • Influence how Spire thinks about automation, data, and AI/ML across the broader engineering organization

Basic Qualifications: 

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 in a technical leadership or staff-level individual contributor role
  • Demonstrated track record building and shipping reliable production systems at scale. You have owned things that could not go down.
  • Deep technical credibility. Engineers on your teams have respected your judgment and not just your title.
  • Experience with SRE principles, reliability engineering, or large-scale automation. You have reduced toil systematically and not just complained about it.
  • Strong foundation in Python, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience hiring and developing engineers. You know what great looks like and how to find it.
  • The communication and influence skills to drive technical decisions across teams you do not directly control

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience applying AI/ML or advanced analytics to operational or monitoring problems
  • Experience writing performance software in Rust
  • Background in space systems, aerospace, or highly constrained real-time environments
  • Experience building data lakes, telemetry platforms, or observability infrastructure at scale
  • A history of leading teams through technical transformations and not just maintaining the status quo

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

data.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer - London
data.description:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Position

The DevSecOps Engineer is a leadership and individual contributor role responsible for maturing our security posture across all engineering departments. You will lead the design and implementation of automated, platform-based security solutions, enabling teams to build secure software while maintaining velocity. You will partner closely with Core Tech, Product, and Engineering leadership to define our security roadmap and culture.

We’re excited about you because you are a trailblazer who balances high-level strategy with hands-on technical execution. You are comfortable building from near-scratch, thrive on educating others, and possess a "platform" mindset that prioritizes empowering developers over acting as a gatekeeper.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and execute a multi-quarter security roadmap for the entire engineering organization.

  • Develop and maintain platform-level security tools that enable automated, self-service security for feature teams.

  • Partner with Core Tech to integrate security primitives into our standard CI/CD and cloud deployment workflows.

  • Conduct cross-team discovery to assess current security posture and identify high-risk technical debt.

  • Mentor junior and peer engineers, fostering a culture where security is integrated into the "you build it, you run it" philosophy.

  • Stay ahead of evolving threat landscapes, specifically regarding supply chain risks and large-scale AI infrastructure.

  • Own and mature our existing detection, SIEM, and incident-response tooling as part of building out the broader security platform — this role inherits live systems, it isn't a blank canvas.

  • Act as a security collaborator to IT on AI-usage risk (data exposure via connectors/agents, prompt injection) — distinct from, and in addition to, securing the AI systems Hiya builds as a product.

Qualities that will make you successful:

  • Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture (AWS) and modern security best practices.

  • Proven experience designing "self-service" platforms that developers actually want to use.

  • Strong communication skills—the ability to turn complex security concerns into decisions engineers and stakeholders can act on.

  • High proficiency in at least one modern language and familiarity with agent-based/AI-assisted development tools.

  • Pragmatism—knowing when to accept calculated tech debt in favor of high-impact outcomes.

  • A leadership style rooted in empathy, collaborative debate, and commitment to team decisions.

  • Builds systems, documentation, and team capability that outlast you — we're wary of highly productive engineers who leave behind bespoke, unmaintainable tooling that has to be scrapped when they move on.

The person in this role must embody Hiya’s key values of Serving our customers, Doing rather than observing, Improving ourselves and our business, Owning and holding ourselves accountable for success, and Leading by showing up with a point of view, engaging in open discussion, listening respectfully to others opinions and committing to decisions.

The requirements listed in the job descriptions are guidelines. You don’t have to satisfy every requirement or meet every qualification listed. If your skills are transferable we would still love to hear from you.

How We Work

Hiya is not a passive environment. We expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems.

We work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy. Context is shared openly, and decisions are discussed, challenged, and then made. Once a call is made, we commit and move forward.

You'll be expected to work through ambiguity, weigh tradeoffs, and take responsibility for results, while keeping a high bar for quality and customer trust.

Every team member at Hiya is expected to live our core values:

  • Serve, our customers and partners by holding a high bar for trust and quality

  • Own, share in success and open up to failures

  • Lead, listen, show up with a point of view but commit entirely once a decision has been made

  • Improve, even if it means changing course or contradicting ourselves

  • Do, rather than observe

How We Invest in You

Compensation & Ownership
Equity Compensation: ownership aligned with your impact and the company's growth

We offer an L&D budget to support your growth and real internal mobility so career pathing isn't just a talking point — because we're building this with people who own the outcome.

 

Come Work With Us!

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!

Hiya is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

  • Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, Occupational Health and Safety, Quality Management, or a related field (preferred).

  • Strong IT skills Microsoft, project, teams, excel, etc.
  • Hands-on Health and Safety culture, leading from the front both at construction sites and in the office.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously.

At Zeeco, we value our employees and are committed to offering a comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being and professional growth, see below some of the great things we offer:
  • BUPA, Medicash, Employee Assistance Program to support your wellbeing.
  • 12% Employer contribution to company pension scheme to help you plan confidently for the future.
  • 27 days holiday (plus bank holidays) so you can recharge and maintain a healthy work–life balance.
  • Life insurance for added peace of mind.
  • Professional growth opportunities, including training, development, and the chance to work alongside world class engineering teams.
  • A supportive, safety driven culture where your expertise is valued and your voice matters.
  • Regular social events to have fun, and enjoy team camaraderie and to promote and protect our culture.
  • Global project exposure, working across Europe and the Middle East with industry leading technology.
The role will be a hybrid role between the office and site-based, with the HSE Engineer spending a split (50/50, site/office) amount of time on construction sites. The position will also require office work for planning and administrative tasks. This role requires hybrid and flexible working to react to business requirements. Including the need to adapt and change plans at short notice, including weekends and evenings on occasion.
Working at Zeeco means being part of a people-centric culture and environment built on mutual respect, personal encouragement, professional integrity, and limitless opportunity. For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career! 

We are looking for a Senior Staff or Staff System Test Engineer to help ensure our products are thoroughly tested and our deliveries are robust, scalable, and production-ready. This is a hands-on role for someone who can take ownership of test initiatives and serve as a trusted technical partner.

Based in Edinburgh, you will work with global cross-functional teams to develop and improve system test methodologies, strengthen our automation capabilities, support and evolve our test management infrastructure, and help maintain an effective lab environment.


Responsibilities:
  • Build comprehensive system test plans for new features and products by translating requirements into effective test coverage.
  • Implement and execute tests across both pre-silicon and post-silicon phases of development.
  • Take a lead role in driving test strategy, planning, coordination, risk management, and clear communication of status and issues.
  • Own and evolve the team’s test management system, helping to ensure that test assets, coverage, execution, and reporting are organised, scalable, and effective.
  • Manage and support test hardware setups, and play a key role in maintaining an efficient, well-structured lab environment.
  • Work closely with software, systems, and other cross-functional teams to identify issues, triage defects, debug failures, and drive timely resolution.
  • Represent System Test in technical discussions, project reviews, and cross-functional forums.

    • Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Strong experience in embedded systems and Real Time Operating Systems (RTOS).
  • Strong experience in software testing and test automation principles, including development of robust, maintainable automated test solutions.
  • Strong experience with scripting in Python.
  • Experience with a variety of MCU and DSP cores/processors.
  • Experience developing and implementing embedded software tests on development boards.
  • Experience using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes and logic analysers for bring-up and debugging.
  • Excellent debugging, problem-solving, organisational, and communication skills.

    • Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • Experience with Jira, Git, and continuous integration systems such as Jenkins.
  • Experience with test management systems.
    • This position is based in our Edinburgh, UK office. 
     
    This is a hybrid remote position and will follow a 2+ day in-office work schedule, with in-office days based on business needs and team preference. You must be based within commutable distance of the work location listed on the job posting, or willing to relocate prior to beginning employment with Cirrus Logic.

data.title: Embedded Software Engineer (NWB)
data.description:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career! 

We’re looking for an Embedded Software Engineer who thrives close to the hardware and enjoys building high-performance, reliable firmware for DSP architecture and microcontrollers (e.g., RISC V and Arm Cortex M/A). You’ll design and implement real-time embedded software, optimize compute-heavy pipelines, and collaborate with hardware and systems teams to bring products from concept to production.
 
This role suits someone who can move comfortably between architecture/design, low-level firmware, and performance tuning—especially where latency, throughput, power, and determinism matter.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design, implement, and maintain embedded firmware for DSP cores and MCUs (RISC V and/or Arm).
  • Build and optimize real-time signal-processing pipelines (fixed-point and/or floating-point), potentially including FFTs, filters, modulation/demodulation, codecs, feature extraction, or control loops.
  • Develop firmware using a mix of C/C++ (and selective assembly where appropriate), with strong focus on performance, memory, and power optimization.
  • Work with SoC/board peripherals: DMA, timers, SPI, I²C, UART, I²S/TDM, PWM, GPIO, and relevant bus fabrics.
  • Bring up new hardware: boot flows, clocks, memory maps, interrupt vectors, peripheral init, and early validation.
  • Implement and debug drivers and RTOS components (e.g., Zephyr or equivalent), including task scheduling, synchronization primitives, and ISR design.
  • Develop test strategies: unit tests, hardware-in-the-loop tests, test automation, and manufacturing/production diagnostics.
  • Use debugging/profiling tools: JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, trace (ETM/ITM), and cycle-accurate profiling when available.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware, FPGA/ASIC, systems, and application teams to define requirements and interfaces.
  • Contribute documentation: architecture notes, interface specs, timing budgets, work packages, and bring-up guides.
  • Participate in code reviews and help establish best practices for embedded quality, safety, and maintainability.

    • Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Strong professional experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ for MCUs and/or DSPs.
  • Hands-on experience with RISC V and/or Arm architecture (Cortex M/A), including interrupts, memory, caches, and performance characteristics.
  • Solid understanding of embedded software fundamentals:
  • register-level programming, memory-mapped I/O
  • concurrency (ISRs, RTOS tasks), race conditions, timing determinism
  • fixed-point arithmetic, numerical precision, and overflow/underflow management
  • Proven ability to optimize firmware: cycle counting, memory layout, DMA usage, cache behavior, minimizing latency and jitter.
  • Comfortable with toolchains and build systems:
  • GCC/LLVM-based toolchains, cross-compilation
  • CMake/Make, Meson, linker scripts, map files
  • Strong debugging skills with hardware and firmware:
  • JTAG/SWD debugging
  • root-cause analysis of timing and performance issues
  • Source control expertise (Git) and disciplined engineering practices (code reviews, CI).

    • Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • Languages: C, C++, (optional) assembly, Python for test tooling/scripts
  • Architectures: RISC V, Arm Cortex M/A, DSP cores
  • RTOS/OS: Zephyr, embedded Linux (optional)
  • Tools: JTAG/SWD debuggers, GDB, OpenOCD/J-Link, logic analyzer, oscilloscope, trace tools
  • Practices: profiling, timing analysis, unit/integration testing, CI/CD for embedded
  • Experience with common DSP libraries/techniques (e.g., CMSIS-DSP, vendor DSP libs) and SIMD/vector optimization patterns.
  • Experience with Zephyr, or embedded Linux on Arm.
  • Familiarity with bootloaders, secure boot, OTA update mechanisms, and field diagnostics.
  • Understanding of digital communications, or audio, processing domains.
  • Exposure to safety/security standards (e.g., MISRA C/C++, IEC 61508, ISO 26262)
    • This Newbury or London based role is a hybrid remote position and will follow a 2 day in-office work schedule, with in-office days based on business needs and team preference. You must be based within commutable distance of the work location listed on the job posting, or willing to relocate prior to beginning employment with Cirrus Logic.

data.title: Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics
data.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

Who you are

We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale.

Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base.

What you’ll do

  • Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

  • Ensure accurate payment cost configuration: Translate complex scheme rules into fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic. Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows.

  • Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution.

  • Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements.

  • Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers. Partner with Product, Finance and Commercial teams to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.

  • Shape pricing and commercial decisions: Translate underlying payment economics into recommendations for customer pricing, product design, new market launches and commercial strategy, ensuring growth is supported by sustainable unit economics.

  • Build scalable infrastructure and automation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to strengthen cost engines, fee allocation logic, dashboards and automated controls. Apply AI and advanced analytics to accelerate rule interpretation, detect anomalies and surface optimization opportunities.

  • Own complex scheme economics issues: Serve as the escalation point for scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions, working directly with Visa, Mastercard and other payment partners where required.

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or related roles, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.

  • Deep knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules.

  • Strong ability to operationalize complex payment rules, translating fee schedules and network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls.

  • Experience with payment cost systems and controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modeling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs.

  • Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to connect detailed payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimization.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale.

  • Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

The DevOps Engineer is a hands-on engineering role within the Platform Engineering team, responsible for supporting and evolving DeepHealth's AWS-based infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD tooling, and operational processes. At Kandou, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

 

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

 

Kandou’s architecture is not just an incremental improvement — it’s a foundational shift in how AI hardware is built for the future.

 

Job Title: Quality Systems Manager

Location: Preferably UK (Cambridge or Reading) - Other location in Europe possible

Responsibility and Authority

  • Design, deliver and manage our quality management system (QMS) in accordance with ISO 9001, (2015 and then transition to 2026), and company requirements.

  • Responsible for quality document administration and control, including Kandou’s Document (DMS) and Issues Management Systems (IMS).

  • Responsible for internal audit of the QMS, support supplier/customer audits and manage the relevant corrective actions/preventative actions (CAPA).

  • Champion customer/legislative driven quality, environmental and ethical initiatives e.g. Responsible Business Alliance, Cyber Security, Green House Gas emissions, etc.

  • Own & present quality metrics, and improvement plans, to management team.

  • Owner of all internal Quality processes e.g. change management, 5S audits, organisational risk management, etc.

  • Own and communicate Kandou’s quality message to suppliers, employees, and customers.

  • Work with commercial, engineering, and operational functions to prioritise and agree on a roadmap of activities for internal and external expectations regarding quality goals.

  • Define and specify the implementation of quality standards, methods, metrics, and procedures for continuous improvement assuring product quality and business performance, including relevant KPI’s.

  • Candidate must demonstrate leadership, communication and influencing skills and is able to communicate with ease with customers, senior management and internal stakeholders.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years’ experience of working with, and implementing, Quality Management Systems within the semiconductor and/or technology industries.

  • Track record of defining quality processes & procedures.

  • Administration of document and issue management systems.

  • Practical experience of data collection, pareto & data analysis / trending.

  • Practical experience of continuous improvement and structured problem solving.

  • Experience of ISO9001 implementation, maintenance and certification. Equivalent knowledge of IATF16949 and/or ISO14001 is desirable.

  • Thorough knowledge of quality improvement tools.

  • Experience in effective collaboration with design, development and manufacturing organizations, particularly as relates to design and product realisation processes.

Required Skills

  • Excellent verbal / written communication, interpersonal and functional team building skills.

  • Working understanding of statistical decision-making methods including process .capability analysis/MSA and DoE. Ability to use statistical analysis tools a plus.

  • Knowledge of 6 Sigma methods and techniques, process control systems, process capability, measurements systems analysis, FMEA, corrective & preventive action, and continuous improvement programs.

  • Competent with Office Products, e.g. Visio, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

  • Able to plan & conduct/support internal, supplier & customer audits.

  • Self starter with the ability to identify issues, work independently, meet the challenge and effect a solution.

  • Practical understanding/application of quality design toolset e.g. FMEA, APQP, etc.

  • Expert knowledge of ISO9001:2015 and it’s application in a technology organisation

Required Education

  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline and/or relevant vocational experience

ClayDR Manager (Sales Development Manager)

Our ClayDRs (SDRs) are the front line: sales professionals who turn high-volume demand into qualified pipeline and great first impressions of Clay. We're still early in building our outbound motion and believe this team is going to shape the arc of Clay's growth story.

As their manager, you'll lead a team of ClayDRs out of our London office. This is a player-coach role. You're in the calls, in the pipeline reviews, and in the weeds on what's working and what isn't. You'll own how we run outbound at Clay and represent the SDR function to sales leadership.

  • Coach in real time. Run call reviews, join live calls, workshop messaging. You set the standard by doing the work, not reviewing it from a dashboard.

  • Own pipeline generation. You're accountable for outbound and inbound qualification, pipeline quality, and the handoff to AEs.

  • Represent the ClayDR function to sales leadership. Bring visibility into pipeline health, outbound performance, and what your team is learning from the market.

  • Develop your people. Define what "great" looks like at every stage, build progression paths, and invest in the growth of each rep on your team.

  • Shape how Clay does outbound. Push your team to prospect creatively using Clay workflows, signals, and enrichment. Bring a point of view on what modern top-of-funnel looks like.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years in GTM roles with 2+ years managing SDR/BDR teams.

  • Prior experience in a closing role.

  • You coach by doing. You've been in the calls, not just the dashboards.

  • Credibility with sales leadership. You speak to pipeline, performance, and market signal in a way that earns trust.

  • Familiarity with modern GTM tooling and real curiosity about AI-driven prospecting.

  • A builder mentality. You want to shape how this team operates, not inherit a playbook.

  • Enthusiasm for building an in-office ClayDR culture. Our team is in 5 days a week.

PE Partnerships @Clay

Clay is building the modern GTM operating system – helping companies transform how they source, enrich, and activate data across sales, marketing, and revenue operations. As Clay's adoption expands across Private Equity firms and their portfolios, we're investing in a dedicated role to build and scale our PE partnerships motion end-to-end.

This is not a traditional sales role and not a 1:1 customer success role – it's a programs and systems role, focused on building repeatable infrastructure that allows Clay to scale across entire portfolios while staying credible in executive and board-level conversations. You'll take the foundation built by our Partnerships, GTM Engineering, and Enterprise teams and turn it into a repeatable PE playbook. Depending on background, you may lean more heavily into one track, but success requires tight integration across both.

About the role

We're hiring a foundational Partnerships hire to build Clay's PE motion from the ground up – from firm entry to portfolio activation to proving value at scale.

This role spans two tightly connected tracks, and we're hiring across both

  1. Private Equity Business Development — shaping how Clay shows up to PE firms, building relationships with Operating Partners and Value Creation teams, and converting interest into pilots and portfolio entry

  2. Portfolio Value Creation & Activation — designing scalable programs that drive Clay adoption, measurable GTM impact, and portfolio-wide expansion

What you’ll do

Private Equity Business Development

How Clay enters PE firms and initiates portfolio motion

  • Map and prioritize the PE landscape – firms, funds, and portfolios aligned with Clay's GTM value

  • Build relationships with Operating Partners and Value Creation teams to understand fund priorities and timing

  • Develop Clay's PE-specific narrative and materials: decks, pilot frameworks, ROI overviews

  • Design portfolio entry models (pilots, GTM diagnostics, enablement cohorts)

  • Convert PE relationships into structured engagement and portfolio introductions

  • Coordinate with GTM Engineering, Enterprise, RevOps, and Legal on pilots and commercial terms

Portfolio Value Creation & Activation

How Clay delivers, measures, and scales value across portfolios

  • Design and execute scaled activation programs (webinars, cohorts, office hours, workshops) that reach many portfolio companies at once

  • Build repeatable infrastructure that drives adoption with minimal 1:1 touch

  • Define portfolio-level success metrics tied to PE value creation (adoption, time-to-value, expansion, ARR growth, GTM efficiency)

  • Convert outcomes into executive-ready narratives: ROI summaries, impact reports, board-level readouts

  • Gather structured feedback and represent PE needs back to Product, Partnerships, and GTM teams

 

What you'll bring

  • Have 6–10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS partnerships, program management, GTM strategy, value creation, consulting, or revenue operations

  • Have experience working with or presenting to Private Equity Operating Partners, Value Creation teams, or portfolio executives

  • Enjoy building scalable programs and systems, not bespoke 1:1 solutions

  • Possess strong systems thinking and comfort designing workflows that reduce manual work

  • Are fluent in translating technical capabilities into business and financial impact

  • Have a strong bias toward measuring what matters (adoption, ARR, efficiency, outcomes)

  • Are comfortable operating in ambiguity and building new motions from scratch

  • Communicate clearly and credibly with senior executives and internal stakeholders

GTM Engineer @ Clay

Our journey to $100M ARR was powered by creativity and a belief that the best GTM teams treat their go-to-market like a product: constantly shipping new plays, experimenting, and never assuming that what worked last quarter will work next quarter. We sell that way too.

We describe ourselves as go-to-market consultants: AEs with a product mindset. We don't just sell Clay. We learn how a prospect's GTM motion actually works and show them what's possible with Clay. Every deal is a net-new customer discovering Clay for the first time. Our motion is high-velocity but consultative; we move fast, but we also go deep. This role won't look the same in six months as it does today, and that's the point. We're looking for people who want to grow alongside us and help redefine what great selling looks like.

  • Prospect into target accounts and build pipeline alongside managing inbound leads

  • Run tailored product evaluations and demos that connect Clay's capabilities to a prospect's specific workflows and pain points

  • Lead consultative discovery that helps prospects see the possibilities of Clay

  • Build business cases that win budget and internal champions

  • Work cross-functionally with product, engineering, services, and customer teams to shape solutions and stay sharp on what Clay can do

  • Help build our sales playbook, processes, and culture as we scale

  • Use AI creatively, whether to improve your workflows or those of your customers
